records.key: Environments you made. Tick one to uninstall spaCR from it; the environment itself is kept.
records.source: Environments you made. Tick one to uninstall spaCR from it; the environment itself is kept.
records.translation: 직접 만든 환경입니다. 하나를 선택하면 그 환경에서 spaCR 패키지를 제거하며, 환경 자체는 유지됩니다.

records.key: The update stopped before installing, because an older copy of spaCR could not be removed:
records.source: The update stopped before installing, because an older copy of spaCR could not be removed:
records.translation: 이전 spaCR 사본을 제거할 수 없어 설치 전에 업데이트가 중단되었습니다:

records.key: These older copies of spaCR will be removed before the new version is installed:
records.source: These older copies of spaCR will be removed before the new version is installed:
records.translation: 새 버전을 설치하기 전에 다음 이전 spaCR 사본이 제거됩니다:

records.key: in use or not permitted; close anything using it and try again
records.source: in use or not permitted; close anything using it and try again
records.translation: 사용 중이거나 권한 없음; 사용 중인 프로그램을 모두 닫고 다시 시도하세요

records.key: needs administrator rights; delete it as an administrator
records.source: needs administrator rights; delete it as an administrator
records.translation: 관리자 권한 필요; 관리자 권한으로 삭제하세요

records.key: no Python found in it; run pip uninstall spacr in that environment
records.source: no Python found in it; run pip uninstall spacr in that environment
records.translation: 이 환경에서 Python 인터프리터를 찾을 수 없음; 그 환경에서 pip uninstall spacr 명령을 실행하세요

records.key: no Python outside the installation could be found to finish the update; run the new installer instead
records.source: no Python outside the installation could be found to finish the update; run the new installer instead
records.translation: 업데이트를 완료할 Python 인터프리터를 설치 위치 밖에서 찾을 수 없음; 대신 새 설치 프로그램을 실행하세요

records.key: not permitted; delete this registry entry by hand
records.source: not permitted; delete this registry entry by hand
records.translation: 권한 없음; 이 레지스트리 항목을 직접 삭제하세요

records.key: refused: a shared folder, not a spaCR installation; remove spaCR from it by hand
records.source: refused: a shared folder, not a spaCR installation; remove spaCR from it by hand
records.translation: 거부됨: spaCR 설치가 아닌 공유 폴더; 그 안의 spaCR 파일을 직접 제거하세요

records.key: refused: not recognisably a spaCR installation; delete it by hand if it is one
records.source: refused: not recognisably a spaCR installation; delete it by hand if it is one
records.translation: 거부됨: spaCR 설치로 확인되지 않음; 설치가 맞다면 직접 삭제하세요

records.key: spaCR will close, remove the older copies, install {version} and start again.
records.source: spaCR will close, remove the older copies, install {version} and start again.
records.translation: spaCR 종료 후 이전 사본을 제거하고 {version} 버전을 설치한 다음 다시 시작합니다.
